# Copilot instructions

Follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root: it is the single source of truth for
project layout, commands, non-negotiable security/privacy rules and conventions.

Key reminders: run `pnpm check` before finishing; validate all data crossing content script →
background → API with `@repo/shared` schemas; only the background service worker calls the API;
code and comments in English, UI copy in Spanish (es-MX); Biome formatting; Conventional Commits.
